title: services.packages.void_grant params
description: Voids a voucher SOLD BY MISTAKE (the wrong voucher, to the wrong customer or rung up twice), services#82. The voucher can no longer be spent anywhere and the row stays as a trail: who voided it, when and why. Only a voucher with no session spent or held can be voided; once it has been used, the way out is correcting the balance. It moves NO money: refunding what was charged is the sales credit note.

grant_id.description: Id of the grant (the voucher purchase) being voided.

reason.description: Why it is voided, in the operator's words. Mandatory: it stays in the audit trail.
